scientific_integrity: The global result is proved by an explicit monotone integral transform. Checked computations are supplementary and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The cost is defined as the KL divergence between a biased binary sign law and its reflection; equality with full physical entropy production is not claimed.
Bounded iid cycle pair law and independent iid sign choices; duration and magnitude within a cycle may be correlated.
Only the sign bias varies; the cycle law is held fixed; finite sampling does not establish global optimality.
The underlying exact renewal-variance and KL identities are prior art; the claimed contribution is their sharp finite-bias global optimization.
title: A sharp two-thirds variability threshold for bias-efficient renewal transport
